profile.name: Adrien Houle
profile.tagline: I build tools that turn pixels into actionable information.
bio: Software engineer passionate about imaging and geospatial data visualization.
I work on systems that handle large volumes of imagery, from scientific processing to the interfaces that make them understandable.
On the side, I tinker with personal projects — from game development to 3D and graphics experiments.

timeline.title: Software engineer — imaging
timeline.summary: Apprenticeship throughout my Ynov years and the masters, then full-time since graduating. Building tools for processing and visualizing geospatial imagery, integrated into web platforms and data services.

timeline.title: M2 — Master Imagine
timeline.summary: Specialization in image, geometry and graphics computing: image processing, discrete geometry, rendering, stereo vision, ML applied to imaging. Degree obtained while in apprenticeship at Geomatys.

timeline.title: M1 — Software, Mobile & IoT Expert
timeline.summary: Cross-platform software development, mobile and connected devices. Apprenticeship at Geomatys.

timeline.title: Bachelor in Computer Science — 3rd year
timeline.summary: Deeper dive into software development and real-time 3D: three.js, game development and web applications. Apprenticeship at Geomatys.

timeline.title: Two-year technical degree in Computer Science
timeline.summary: Foundations of programming, algorithms and object-oriented development in Java.

timeline.title: Personal projects
timeline.summary: Game development, 3D experiments, physics simulations, interactive sites and graphics tooling in C++, OpenGL, Unity, Angular and Three.js.

projects.name: Ship Rider
projects.description: Boat racing game in development with Charles Roby and Maxime Béziat. Full single-player mode, multiplayer in progress.

projects.name: Space Around
projects.description: Three.js site built in 48h during a team exercise at Ynov, around space tourism.

projects.name: Indiagram
projects.description: Simple social network in Angular, built as a team with Gaël Parain, Maxime Béziat and Charles Roby.

projects.name: OpenGL Project
projects.description: Explorable 3D scene with dynamic lighting and a shooting system, built with Rohan Ferre.

projects.name: Portfolio
projects.description: This site — rebuilt in Angular and Tailwind, with a timeline and a project gallery.

projects.name: Fluids3D-cpp
projects.description: 3D fluid simulation in C++/Qt based on the shallow water equations, with OpenGL rendering: GLSL shaders, skybox, grid, spheres and raymarching. M2 Imagine project.

projects.name: WMS Environment Analyzer
projects.description: Tool for analyzing WMS imagery to detect and classify natural environments. Two approaches: algorithmic and machine learning. Built with Yahnis Saint-Val during the M2 Imagine.

projects.name: Magical Carnage
projects.description: Unity game using hand tracking to cast procedural spells. Experiment around gestures and procedural generation of magical effects.

projects.name: Slope Game
projects.description: Java project built with Rohan Ferre at the IUT — a board game around the game of slopes.

projects.name: Qt Recipes
projects.description: Recipe management app in C++/Qt, built with Rohan Ferre at the IUT — one of my first C++ projects, with Doxygen documentation and state diagrams.
